reasoning_content:
npm i completed (with warnings about install scripts). I'm thinking about checking whether node_modules was actually created, but there are warnings about scripts that weren't executed — libxmljs2 and es5-ext have postinstall scripts. These might be important. I'll check whether node_modules exists and try running the gulp build to see if it works. If libxmljs2 fails due to missing prebuilds, gulp-sass might depend on it.

Actually, package.json uses gulp-sass with dart-sass (the "sass" package), so libxmljs2 might be an indirect dependency. First I'll check the status, then run importDump and cp config, and after that do the build.
